Daraufhin habe ich den Support kontaktiert. Mir wurde mitgeteilt, ich solle das Konto erneut erstellen und mich neu verifizieren — inklusive Pass-Scan und Selfie. Das habe ich gefühlt über 30-mal versucht. Jedes Mal tritt ein Fehler auf und ich soll den Vorgang von vorne beginnen. Der Fehler liegt nicht bei mir, sondern offensichtlich bei Revolut selbst, da meine Dokumente blockiert werden. Besonders fragwürdig ist, dass Revolut das Geld einfach einbehält, ohne mich per E-Mail oder auf anderem Weg darüber zu informieren, was mit dem Geld passieren soll oder wie ich es zurückerhalte. Seit über sechs Wochen meldet sich niemand bei mir aktiv, obwohl Revolut mein Geld ohne rechtliche Grundlage zurückhält. Ich habe den Fall inzwischen an den Financial Ombudsman weitergeleitet, da ich mir anders offenbar keinen Zugang mehr zu meinem eigenen Geld verschaffen kann. Dass ein Finanzdienstleister so mit Kundengeldern und Kommunikation umgeht, ist in meinen Augen absolut inakzeptabel und höchst bedenklich. Esa anécdota hizo que tampoco quisiera seguir con ellos porque aún exponiendo esta postura como cliente me dijeron que ellos no tenían control sobre empresas terceras y que no podían hacer nada para que se me reembolsasen esos 4 euros salvo darme el número para que yo diese de baja ese supuesto servicio. review_text: Una vergüenza de banco que, por su forma de actuar, no debería gestionar premios de la lotería.. Acudí a BBVA con cita previa confirmada para la gestión de un premio de lotería, un servicio regulado que el banco está autorizado a realizar. A pesar de ello, se me negó la atención exclusivamente por no ser cliente, sin revisar documentación ni valorar el trámite, y sin ofrecer una alternativa razonable más allá de esperar semanas para otra cita. Esta actuación es especialmente grave teniendo en cuenta que solo existen dos bancos autorizados en España para el cobro de premios mayores de lotería y que el plazo legal para cobrarlos es de únicamente tres meses. Negar la atención con cita previa en este contexto no es una simple molestia, sino un bloqueo real al ejercicio de un derecho. Este tipo de actuación no puede atribuirse a una sola oficina: refleja un problema de criterio y de procedimiento del banco como entidad, especialmente grave en servicios públicos regulados como el cobro de premios oficiales. Cuando un banco condiciona la atención en la gestión de premios de lotería a ser cliente, se pone en cuestión si debería seguir estando autorizado para gestionar este tipo de premios. Un banco normal vería a una persona que ha ganado la lotería como un cliente potencial. BBVA no. Por esta experiencia, no recomiendo BBVA como banco, especialmente para gestiones sensibles, reguladas o urgentes. January 9, 2026 A day ago

Came good for me when all others had failed!. Came good for me when all others had failed! Around 8 years ago, I had to set up new accounts and get a rather eye watering loan to pay off debts accrued by my now ex wife and buy her out of my business. I finally got divorced and had more debt to clear up than I want to even remember. A somewhat desperate conversation with a colleague led him to tell me he had previously had a good experience with them when he set up his own business, so I called Santander while working on a job there and then. Within little more than an hour, I had laid the foundations to set up a new personal account, two new business accounts and got a business loan to get my new business back on track. Never had to go to a branch, never missed even an hour of work, did it all on the phone while I was working. In the 8 years that have followed, I have moved pretty much everything I can into the hands of Santander and I can honestly say they have given me pretty much faultless service! I now have their credit card, their mortgage, their Euro corporate currency accounts, business current accounts, Deposit accounts and now also a COVID19 bounce Back loan which has helped me tremendously. The Cashback I get from both my credit card and my personal current account more than covers the monthly charges, in fact it's almost double what it costs in bank charges, so no complaints from me at all. If you want me to find fault, it is that if I want to pay a cheque in, I have to travel a fair way to find a branch, but tend to route past one when I need to and I can always post cheques to them if I wanted to. In practice, these days, if I get one or two cheques a year it's as much as I see, so not a huge problem. November 23, 2021 Oct 26, 2021

review_text: Caixa - some tips and warnings.. Banking in Spain is a pain in the neck - anyway. What I learned is: 1) Caixabank will never give you a complete overview of your account online (no daily limits, BIQ, IBAN). I wrote a letter to change that - information is everything. I am still waiting. 2) Never use the possibility "pay in three months" - interest is enormous and before you realize you will find yourself in financial trouble. The amounts may be small, but combined and used several times - you will run into a problem. This option is offered for any purchase above 50 EUR. I seems, they did not read the book "The Moneychangers" as this question is 40 years old. 3) To be confirmed - but it appears to me, that if you use the ATM of your own bank (ATM) each time a fee of 2 EUR will be charged to your account. To avoid this, pay everything by card (but NOT contactless - I had three cases where the amount was debited twice. No chance to get this back). Always insert the card and type your code. Old fashioned, but secure. Cash: take everything once or twice a month. Point. 4) Never ever take credit - they always offer you credit up to 20.000 or so within 5 minutes. Interest is enormous. To be avoided. 5) What is good - sometimes they have special offers (I am not talking about a TV or a Trottinette) but I bought a real 125 scooter and pay 100 EUR month including full complete insurance, This was a very good deal. 6) If you are retired, you will NOT receive the present when opening an account (which I find completely unacceptable). I will not die tomorrow, ok? In my case a TV was promised, but finally I did not get it. I am still alive and my retirement is really good. This is a shame for a bank like this. 7) Worst is - savings: Do not use this bank for savings. I did it once, to try: 1.000 EUR for 3 months and received 1,24 EUR interest out of which 0.24 were taxes. So 1 EUR for 1000 EUR for three months is equivalent to 0,1% for three months, 0,4 % per year. Check via internet. I found another bank for savings, which I will use - 2% guaranteed, you can save as much as you want and you can use it when you want - no time limit. That means, that in the end you will work with two banks - a regular and one for your savings. On top of this, savings at CAIXA must be a minimum of 500 EUR each time. They will not accept less. Bad mistake. 8) Everything is done quickly and in Spanish - be careful before you sign anything. 9) Staff does not speak any other language (normally) than ES. So some ES knowledge is really necessary to deal with them. I have used three banks over the years in Spain. I stay with Caixa now - but I observe the above rules. So should you.
